title: Game inspired self care space! Need feedback!
author: lookup765
selftext:
Hi everyone! I'm Bryony and I've been working on something called Little Lantern (unless I change my mind again 😆)  I'm looking for people who can have a play around and let me know what you think. Right now I have no idea if this has just been a fun hyperfocus resulting in something that works for me and basically no one else or if this could actually help people!

It's not technically a game but inspired by cosy games, it's a gentle, cosy space for reflection and self care, built around the idea that some days you have lots of capacity and other days you really don't - (ADHD, depression, anxiety, fibromyalgia, heds and a couple others in the mix for me)

I wanted to create something that's basically the opposite to the habit tracker productivity maxing apps. No streaks, no pressure to be productive and no guilt if you disappear for a few days. Just a space to check in with yourself and find small ways to look after yourself, coz the hard days shouldn't expect Bryony to show up perfectly and do the yoga and the workout and the rest of it, I should be allowed to show up as I can, where gently rolling my shoulders and making myself a coffee is still a successful morning.

So yeah, now I need help! I'm particularly keen to hear from people with ADHD, chronic illness or fluctuating energy levels, as I built this for us! But all views welcome 🤗 

It's still very much a work in progress, so I'm not expecting people to tell me how lovely it is! I'd much rather hear what's confusing, what doesn't work, what you like and whether it's something you'd actually want to come back to, and if not do you know someone who would? (Trying to work out how niche this is!)

If anyone fancies giving it a try, I'd really appreciate it. And honestly, any feedback would be hugely helpful. ❤️ DM me or comment and I'll shoot you the link! 

TL;DR: Little Lantern is a cosy, game inspired space for reflection and self-care, designed for people whose capacity fluctuates. - please help me work out if this can help people! Ty in advance!
